label: G ff2 swim-away-day base-vs-arm
brief: Four moments 0.3 s apart (left to right, top to bottom) from one fixed swimming camera in a Tidewake sea current, the trainer swimming. Judge how the water surface looks - whether it reads as natural moving water in the key art's world (not artefacts, flicker or hard-edged shapes) - and whether the current's direction reads from the water on a 7-inch handheld screen.
defects: The swimming current's direction cannot be read from the swimmer view at a glance on a 7-inch screen
